name: f2-gdx-skill-latent-representations
description: DB reader/writer for the F2_GDX_SKILL_LATENT_REPRESENTATIONS (F2) skill: fits PCA (so far -- autoencoder/UMAP are a later increment) on the z-scored feature vectors F1_GDX_SKILL_MULTIDIMENSIONAL_FEATURE_SPACE already wrote, and records the resulting latent representation into the GDX_HNF_LATENT_* tables, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
